Thanks Marissa — read the packet this morning. Quick thoughts from ENG direction:

1) Role fit and org need
- GreenTech's problem space (real-time energy optimization) maps closely to teams we staff for L6/Staff impact. This candidate has both hands-on infra experience and product-facing system ownership, which is rare at L5.

2) Manager vs Staff trade-offs
- If we hire as L5 Manager we get immediate people leadership but may underutilize the candidate's system-level design strengths.
- If we hire as L6/Staff and subsequently hire a front-line manager, there is risk around matrix management and compensation optics.

3) Recommendation
- Recommend offering at an L5+ (manager) title with explicit technical leadership banding: title = "L5 Engineering Manager (Applied ML)" but with an elevated responsibilities clause and an automatic leveling review at 9 months tied to specific deliverables (system ownership, cross-team roadmap). Compensation: place base near the top of the L5 band (suggest base $235k) and an accelerated performance review (possible promotion to L6/Staff plus equity refresh at 9 months if milestones met).

Rationale: this mitigates hiring risk for the org headcount plan while signaling technical growth and preserving market competitiveness. If comp approves, we can finalize wording and outbound the offer tomorrow.
